record.field: today = datetime.datetime.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d') last_month = (datetime.datetime.today() - datetime.timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') rec = env['account.move'].search([('date', '<=', today), ('date', '>=', last_month), ('move_type', '=', 'in_invoice')]) model.get_xml_content(rec)

env.cr.execute(""" UPDATE account_move_line aml SET analytic_account_display = COALESCE(sub.nuevo_nombre, 'Sin Cuenta Analítica') FROM ( SELECT aml_inner.id, aaa.name ->> 'es_MX' AS nuevo_nombre FROM account_move_line aml_inner LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT acc.id AS account_id FROM jsonb_each(aml_inner.analytic_distribution::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS kv(key, value, ord) CROSS JOIN LATERAL string_to_table(kv.key, ',') WITH ORDINALITY AS sub_k(account_str, sub_ord) JOIN account_analytic_account acc ON acc.id = sub_k.account_str::int WHERE acc.plan_id != 78 AND acc.active IS TRUE ORDER BY kv.ord, sub_k.sub_ord LIMIT 1 ) k ON aml_inner.analytic_distribution IS NOT NULL AND aml_inner.analytic_distribution::text != '{}' LEFT JOIN account_analytic_account aaa ON aaa.id = k.account_id ) sub WHERE aml.id = sub.id; """)
